problem: Production Source Snapshot runs were repeatedly cancelled whenever main advanced, preventing exact-main deployment from reaching Netlify under concurrent agent delivery.
root_cause: The workflow concurrency group used cancel-in-progress=true. With frequent protected-main writes, a healthy in-flight production deploy was killed before exact-SHA and browser readback could complete.
prevention: Production Source Snapshot must never cancel a healthy in-flight deploy merely because main advanced.
Use one serialized running production snapshot and allow GitHub concurrency to coalesce waiting work to the newest pending run.
Current-main terminal proof must come from the newest completed snapshot after the active deploy finishes.
Do not create duplicate deploy recovery PRs to escape concurrency cancellation.

evidence.observed_pattern: healthy exact-main deploy cancelled after main movement
